g.text: The debugger must sense target 3V3 on VTREF; it must not source 3V3 into the board. PB3 is SPI3_SCK, therefore SWO is NC in Rev A.

g.desc: The debugger must sense target 3V3 on VTREF; it must not source 3V3 into the board. PB3 is SPI3_SCK, therefore SWO is NC in Rev A.

g.text: BOOT0 shares PB8 with feedback I/H3. The mux is disabled during reset; the 1k button path permits deliberate ROM-boot entry without hard-shorting an active encoder output.
